world.name: Round Room
world.description: This is a circular stone room with passages in all directions. Several of them have unfortunately been blocked by cave-ins.

world.name: North-South Passage
world.description: This is a high north-south passage, which forks to the northeast.

world.name: Chasm
world.description: A chasm runs southwest to northeast and the path follows it. You are on the south side of the chasm, where a crack opens into a passage.

world.name: Deep Canyon
world.description: You are on the south edge of a deep canyon. Passages lead off to the east, northwest and southwest. A stairway leads down.

world.name: Damp Cave
world.description: This cave has exits to the west and east, and narrows to a crack toward the south. The earth is particularly damp here.

world.name: Loud Room
world.description: This is a large room with a ceiling which cannot be detected from the floor. There are exits to the east and west, and a staircase leading up. The room is deafeningly loud with an undetermined source of noise.

children.name: platinum bar
children.description: On the ground is a large platinum bar.

overrides.guardedText: You cannot even hear yourself think in here.

children.name: echo
children.description: The room's own voice, shouting back at you.

children.name: echo
children.description: The room's own voice, shouting back at you.

signal.text: The acoustics of the room change subtly.

world.name: Dam
world.description: You are standing on the top of the Flood Control Dam #3, which was quite a tourist attraction in times far distant. There are paths to the north, south, and west, and a scramble down. The sluice gates are shut, and the stream is quiet. Behind the dam, there is a large lake, which is almost ready to overflow the dam.

world.name: Dam Lobby
world.description: This room appears to have been the waiting room for groups touring the dam. There are open doorways here to the north and east marked "Private", and there is a path leading south over the top of the dam.

children.name: matchbook
children.description: There is a matchbook whose cover says "Visit Beautiful FCD#3" here.

overrides.text: You are in a large room with a large door presumably to the east. There is a sign on the wall reading "Flood Control Dam #3 Hutber and Lil, Consulting Engineers".

children.name: tour guidebook

overrides.text: The guidebook is mostly ruined by water damage. A few paragraphs remain legible: "Welcome to Flood Control Dam #3... The dam was constructed in 783 GUE... FCD#3 was presumably built to control the great seasonal fluctuations of the Frigid River..."

children.firstDescription: Some guidebooks entitled "Flood Control Dam #3" are on the reception desk.

world.name: Maintenance Room
world.description: This is what appears to have been the maintenance room for Flood Control Dam #3. Apparently, this room has been ransacked recently, for most of the valuable equipment is gone. On the wall in front of you is a group of buttons colored blue, yellow, brown, and red. There are doorways to the west and south.

overrides.pressText: There is a rumbling sound and a stream of water appears to burst from the east wall, apparently from a pipe which runs from the reservoir.

say.text: The blue button appears to be jammed.
There is a rumbling sound and a stream of water appears to burst from the east wall, apparently from a pipe which runs from the reservoir.

children.name: tube
children.description: There is an object which looks like a tube of toothpaste here.

say.text: The leak is plugged, and the remaining water drains away.

world.name: Reservoir South
world.description: You are in a long room. To the north is a large lake, too deep to cross. To the east there is a small stream flowing out of a hole in the rock about three feet up. Through the stream, you can see a main tunnel leading into darkness.

world.name: Reservoir
world.description: You are on the gently flowing stream. The upstream route is too narrow to navigate, and the downstream route is invisible due to twisting walls. There is a narrow beach to land on.

children.name: trunk of jewels
children.description: There is an old trunk here, bulging with assorted jewels.
children.firstDescription: Lying half buried in the mud is an old trunk, bulging with jewels.

world.name: Reservoir North
world.description: You are in a large cavernous area. To the south is a wide lake, whose water level appears to be falling rapidly.

world.name: Stream View
world.description: You are standing on a path beside a gently flowing stream. The path follows the stream, which flows from west to east.

world.name: Stream
world.description: You are on the gently flowing stream. The upstream route is too narrow to navigate, and the downstream route is invisible due to twisting walls. There is a narrow beach to land on.

world.name: dam state
world.description: The shared state of Flood Control Dam #3.

signal.text: The sluice gates open and water pours through the dam.
The sluice gates close and water starts to collect behind the dam.
You hear what sounds like rushing water in the distance.
You hear what sounds like surging water in the distance.

rename.description: You are standing on the top of the Flood Control Dam #3, which was quite a tourist attraction in times far distant. There are paths to the north, south, and west, and a scramble down. The sluice gates on the dam are closed. Behind the dam, there can be seen a wide reservoir. Water is pouring over the top of the now abandoned dam. There is a control panel here, on which a large metal bolt is mounted. Directly above the bolt is a small green plastic bubble.

You are standing on the top of the Flood Control Dam #3, which was quite a tourist attraction in times far distant. There are paths to the north, south, and west, and a scramble down. The sluice gates are open, and water rushes through the dam. The water level behind the dam is still high. There is a control panel here, on which a large metal bolt is mounted. Directly above the bolt is a small green plastic bubble.

You are standing on the top of the Flood Control Dam #3, which was quite a tourist attraction in times far distant. There are paths to the north, south, and west, and a scramble down. The water level behind the dam is low: The sluice gates have been opened. Water rushes through the dam and downstream. There is a control panel here, on which a large metal bolt is mounted. Directly above the bolt is a small green plastic bubble.

You are standing on the top of the Flood Control Dam #3, which was quite a tourist attraction in times far distant. There are paths to the north, south, and west, and a scramble down. The sluice gates are closed. The water level in the reservoir is quite low, but the level is rising quickly. There is a control panel here, on which a large metal bolt is mounted. Directly above the bolt is a small green plastic bubble.
You are in a long room on the south shore of a large lake, far too deep and wide for crossing.

You are in a long room. To the north is a large lake, too deep to cross. You notice, however, that the water level appears to be dropping at a rapid rate. Before long, it might be possible to cross to the other side from here.
You are in a long room, to the north of which was formerly a lake. However, with the water level lowered, there is merely a wide stream running through the center of the room.

You are in a long room, to the north of which is a wide area which was formerly a reservoir, but now is merely a stream. You notice, however, that the level of the stream is rising quickly and that before long it will be impossible to cross here.
You are in a large cavernous room, north of a large lake. There is a slimy stairway leaving the room to the north.
You are in a large cavernous area. To the south is a wide lake, whose water level appears to be falling rapidly. There is a slimy stairway leaving the room to the north.

You are in a large cavernous room, the south of which was formerly a lake. However, with the water level lowered, there is merely a wide stream running through there. There is a slimy stairway leaving the room to the north.

You are in a cavernous area, to the south of which is a very wide stream. The level of the stream is rising rapidly, and it appears that before long it will be impossible to cross to the other side. There is a slimy stairway leaving the room to the north.

This is a large room with a ceiling which cannot be detected from the floor. There are exits to the east and west, and a staircase leading up. The room is deafeningly loud with an undetermined source of noise.
This is a large room with a ceiling which cannot be detected from the floor. There are exits to the east and west, and a staircase leading up. The room is eerie in its quietness.

rename.name: glowing bubble
rename.description: A translucent green plastic bubble, glowing serenely.

rename.name: green bubble
rename.description: A translucent green plastic bubble, quiet for now.

signal.text: You are ankle-deep in water and rising.
The water is up to your waist now.

endsGame.text: The room is now full of water, and so are your lungs.
